rows: backlog.body.weave_reed_rope
Known terms: Spend one of your two opening sap units to make one actual Survey rope.|A living reedling body and one remaining sap unit are required.
backlog.body.meet_brasswright
Known terms: Introduce one actual brasswright and her one serialized specimen.|
backlog.body.buy_brass_lung
Known terms: Transfer two owned logs to Sella and receive her actual brass lung.|The actual participant has not been introduced.
backlog.body.install_brass_lung
Known terms: Install your own unborrowed specimen in your supported human body. The loose item leaves your bag.|Own the one uninstalled brass lung first.
backlog.body.train_brass_lung
Known terms: Pay Sella one log for her one available lesson. Installation alone grants no usable control.|Install the actual compatible brass lung first.
backlog.body.fuel_brass_lung
Known terms: Consume one owned log for two pressure uses, only when its chamber is empty.|Install the actual compatible brass lung first.
backlog.body.press_brass_seal
Known terms: Consume one Sound seal blank and one pressure unit to make a Fitted parcel seal.|Install the actual compatible brass lung first.
backlog.body.suppress_brass_lung
Known terms: Disable the installed source while retaining the device, learned control and unused pressure.|Install the actual compatible brass lung first.
backlog.body.activate_brass_lung
Known terms: Reactivate the same installed specimen after learning its control.|Install the actual compatible brass lung first.
backlog.body.remove_brass_lung
Known terms: Return the same specimen to your bag and vent unused pressure. Learned control remains.|Install the actual compatible brass lung first.
backlog.body.meet_clay_vessel
Known terms: Introduce one actual stationary clay body with its own possessions and reserve.|
backlog.body.ask_clay_vessel
Known terms: Obtain Tern's explicit consent for one of at most two controlled visits and an agreed return at the Village.|The actual participant has not been introduced.
backlog.body.possess_clay_vessel
Known terms: Park your original body and move Tern's actual body and physical reserve under your control. Neither host goods nor resources transfer.|The actual participant has not been introduced.
backlog.body.press_clay_seal

Known terms: Use one unit of Tern's physical stamina and your own Sound seal blank. Ordinary travel, combat and work wait for your return.|Control the consenting actual clay hands with remaining physical stamina first.
backlog.body.return_from_clay
Known terms: Restore your parked body and Tern's control. The clay body keeps the stamina it spent.|The actual participant has not been introduced.
backlog.body.meet_family
Known terms: Introduce two living family members, two logs, one template and Mara's actual workbench right.|
backlog.body.offer_family_succession
Known terms: Mara willingly offers the two logs, template, taught method and workbench right to Ren.|The actual participant has not been introduced.
backlog.body.revoke_family_succession
Known terms: Withdraw consent before property or rights move.|The actual participant has not been introduced.
backlog.body.accept_family_succession
Known terms: Ren accepts; conserve the stock, transfer the same right and teach the one funded method. Both people stay alive.|The actual participant has not been introduced.
backlog.body.return_family_succession
Known terms: Before any production, return the two logs, template and same right. Ren retains what he learned.|The actual participant has not been introduced.
backlog.body.prepare_family_kit
Known terms: Ren must hold the actual workbench right, template, one log, learned method and one effort unit.|The actual participant has not been introduced.
backlog.body.receive_family_kit
Known terms: Transfer one already produced Prepared survey kit from Ren to your native bag.|The actual participant has not been introduced.
backlog.loop.open

Known terms: One original trial, at most three attempts and two rewinds. Your actual body, local focus, bell-yard facts and keeper restore; common time, knowledge and claims stay. The paid log cannot leave the seal.|Insufficient, stale or unavailable item quantity. Refresh the trade.
backlog.loop.practice

Known terms: Spend two actual stamina, one health and local focus. The keeper spends the sealed log. This changes both live bodies and the actual work site; nothing is exported.|Open the finite bell-yard trial first.
backlog.loop.rewind
Known terms: Restore the declared actual local domains on the same people. Keep the minute already spent and what both people learned. Two rewinds maximum.|Open the finite bell-yard trial first.
backlog.loop.finish

Known terms: Restore the trial body state, consume the single sealed log, settle the retained claim and reopen ordinary native actions. No stock or reward is copied out.|Open the finite bell-yard trial first.
backlog.offline.arm

Known terms: Prepay three kits and pause ordinary play. Each needs two actual wall seconds, equivalent to two native game minutes; six minutes total. Nothing advances without your elapsed review.|Insufficient, stale or unavailable item quantity. Refresh the trade.
backlog.offline.request

Known terms: Explicitly review up to six actual elapsed minutes for the remaining funded kits. This control waits for that full wall interval; unsupported elapsed time is reported and discarded.|Arm or explicitly resume a funded packing batch first.
backlog.offline.pause
Known terms: Keep the remaining prepaid inputs. Discard the current unreviewed wall window; paused wall time earns nothing.|There is no unspent packing batch.
backlog.offline.resume
Known terms: Start a fresh supported wall window for the remaining paid kits. Paused time and previously discarded time cannot be replayed.|There is no unspent packing batch.
backlog.offline.cancel
Known terms: Return only the unspent prepaid logs and coins once. Already packed kits remain actual owned stock.|There is no unspent packing batch.
backlog.fate_offer
Known terms: Meet a new willing keeper. One existing packing entitlement belongs to Rill; this meeting transfers no access or reward.|
backlog.fate_transfer
Known terms: Rill consents to transfer one scarce entitlement and lend one actual Survey rope. Only its recipient may redeem it; Rill loses that slot.|This chance is not awaiting its first transfer.
backlog.fate_settle

Known terms: Use the exclusive bench opportunity. Spend one actual log, return the borrowed rope and receive Rill’s one funded survey kit. The entitlement settles once.|Accept the actual transferred chance first.
backlog.fate_return
Known terms: Return the exact loan and relinquish this chance without a kit. The finite slot closes and cannot be offered again.|Accept the actual transferred chance first.
backlog.ecology_join
Known terms: Rill retains ownership and consents to three finite renewal rounds. You receive harvesting rights; planting, outputs and supply payments require later actions.|
backlog.ecology_plant

Known terms: Spend one actual log as mulch and one of Rill’s three root divisions. Two growing shoots occupy the bed; no actor stays reserved and no wall-clock catch-up occurs.|Agree to the actual reed-bed work rights first.
backlog.ecology_harvest

Known terms: After ten played minutes, cut the two actual standing shoots into two native Cooking herbs. An immature or already cut crop gives no output.|Agree to the actual reed-bed work rights first.
backlog.ecology_supply

Known terms: Transfer two owned native Cooking herbs to Rill. Each completed harvest opens one finite order, funded by two coins from Rill’s actual six-coin purse.|Agree to the actual reed-bed work rights first.
backlog.ecology_close
Known terms: After all three harvests and supply orders, settle the harvesting rights. The owner, paid stock and remembered work remain.|Agree to the actual reed-bed work rights first.
backlog.replacement.meet
Known terms: Meet the seal steward, counter clerk and a longtime colleague. Hearing their actual terms changes no identity, office, duty or possessions.|Invalid knowledge attribution.
